thread:
emma: Hey team — I'm starting a small refresh of the Quickstart 'Hello' playbook. Goal: simplify auth helpers, make the sample app runnable in one step, and fix the broken link to the SDK v9 snippet. I'll open a PR with the restructured snippets in /examples/hello-playbook.

jon: Nice. Can you call out what the one-step run looks like? I want to update the CI smoke check too.

emma: Plan is: consolidate env var names and add a tiny wrapper script. Example in README will be `npm run dev` that sets required env vars via `.env.local.example` and `./scripts/start.sh`. Short snippet I'll include:```bash
# .env.local.example
REDWOOD_API_KEY=your_key_here
REDWOOD_API_REGION=us-west1
```
and the start script:```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
if [ -f .env.local ]; then source .env.local; fi
node ./server/index.js
```

lukas: Can we avoid `REDWOOD_` prefix? We've had confusion about `REDWOOD_API_KEY` vs `REDWOOD_TOKEN` in older docs.

emma: I'm keeping `REDWOOD_API_KEY` for now and will add a migration note: map OLD_API_TOKEN -> REDWOOD_API_KEY. I'll add a short sentence in the auth section: "If migrating from legacy samples, rename OLD_API_TOKEN to REDWOOD_API_KEY and update your CI secrets."

jon: Sounds good. Also, the SDK v9 link is 404 in the current quickstart. Can you paste the new link in the PR? I'll add a test to the docs CI to verify external links.

emma: Yup — new link is https://sdk.redwood.ai/v9/quickstart (will include). Docs CI job: `docs:linkcheck` should fail on 404s — I'll wire it to run on the PR.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs linter will run on PR and may reformat Markdown headings.

lukas: For reviewers: @jon can you take the auth and CI changes, @emma will handle sample app reorg, I'll do the narrative polish and screenshots.

emma: Opening PR shortly: #4823. Draft checklist in PR description: - consolidate env examples - add start script - update README run steps - update SDK link to v9 - add migration note - add CI linkcheck job - update one failing test in examples smoke (should be tiny)

jon: I'll review tomorrow morning. Quick note: preserve the existing small-memory Dockerfile stanza for on-prem customers.

emma: Will keep Dockerfile as-is and add a "quick run" note that doesn't require Docker.

lukas: Minor nit — update the screenshot alt text to include "Hello Playbook sample" for accessibility.

emma: Added to checklist.

jon: :thumbsup: If PR is green we can merge and push a docs release. I can coordinate a small announcement in #announcements.

emma: Great. If anyone spots more legacy token names in other quickstarts, drop them here and I'll sweep them in this PR.

lukas: Found one: `starterkit/hello-lite/README.md` refers to OLD_API_TOKEN. I'll paste the path in the PR comments.

emma: Awesome — thanks. Closing note: aim to merge by EOD Friday to align with SDK v9 rollout.

jon: Ack.
